frozen_question: Do PLACEMENT, CUSTODY and INTERNAL_STRUCTURE channels allow the reverse pass to select one pre-Veta identity history over matched surrogate histories without semantic retuning?
frozen_pass_condition: At least two independent channels must converge on the same identity-bearing invariant and the reverse pass must select one pre-Veta history over matched surrogate histories without semantic retuning.

A_PLACEMENT.primary_result: Quibell's protected burial context places the gold on the body below the limestone slab and explicitly describes rough gold-foil sheaths used to cover fingers, toes and the phallus.
A_PLACEMENT.interpretation: CG53469 belongs first to an anatomically deployed human funerary body-trapping context, not to an uncontextualized separately deposited relic class.

B_CUSTODY.primary_result: The tomb was disturbed before official intervention, but the lower burial carrying the gold was hidden beneath an additional limestone slab from the workmen until inspector Aly Habib opened it. Later catalogue evidence resolves the phallus sheath specifically as CG53469 / JE35425.
B_CUSTODY.critical_correction: Do not equate the general pre-control tomb disturbance with a demonstrated substitution or theft of CG53469 itself. The current evidence weakens placement of Veta at the initial workmen-theft event for this object.

Veta_boundary_update.reason: The relevant lower burial and its gold were protected under an additional slab until official inspection; no evidence currently shows CG53469 itself crossed a substitution boundary there.

Sah_identity_analogue.lesson: Preserving frame/context cannot prove that the central identity was substituted. A substitution boundary must be evidenced, not inferred from the fact that a substitute model is imaginable.
Sah_identity_analogue.mapping_to_current_gate: Mendes + Osirian context + phallus function is the preserved frame; current evidence identifies the central physical object first as Nesbanebdjedet funerary equipment. No observed edge yet demonstrates replacement of an earlier original center.

next_gate.question: Was CG53469 manufactured/assembled as part of the Nesbanebdjedet funerary body kit, or was a pre-existing object incorporated into that kit?
next_gate.frozen_rule: Do not call pre-existing reuse merely because the object is unusual. Reuse requires at least one positive temporally discriminating invariant, and promotion toward a special/relic identity requires an independent second channel.
next_gate.external_wait: Current conservation/custody request is already active; do not send another follow-up before 2026-08-25.
